title: Pollinator Road
summary: Start: enter Pollinator Road. The log opens the job and the helm marks the Lighter Pilot. Do: come within 480 meters of the Lighter Pilot. The tow matches your nose and reads the livestock duty. The Moth Tender walks the perch pocket. A raider takes that lighter inside 1100 meters. Finish: after the lighter is met, come inside Moth Lane's shell. The Charter writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
